description: TWO INERT MEMBERS AND ONE FAILING ONE. This is the case the task asks for: the wrapper reports each n/a with its own reason lifted from the member's output, and still ends on RESULT FAIL. An inert member is not a passing member and must not dilute the count — 'n/a' and 'OK' print differently for exactly that reason, and the count says 1 of 6, not 1 of 4.

param([string]$Root, [string]$Branch, [switch]$All, [switch]$Check)

exit 1
